records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Timber Partners* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-09-20) but no key milestone in 6 days and no invite sent; admin never replied to the welcome note [email:ab3cc4c2], no tickets filed, so no signal of active use. Starter plan, solo user, 8 days left. Early project creation gives some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Quick help getting your first project moving
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Following up on my note from last week — you've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main hurdle. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work you're tracking is the natural next step.

If it would help, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through how you'd like your work structured — just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
Priya
